candidates.statement: Payment authorizations are slow: payment p95 latency is ~4875ms while gateway/order checkout p95 is ~2406ms and traces show ReadTimeout on POST payment, propagating 502s to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show 200s on /v1/authorizations; the slow path may be a subset. No payment logs admitted to confirm internal cause.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout failing with ReadTimeout on POST payment, and payment p95 latency (~4875ms) exceeds gateway/order checkout p95 (~2406ms), consistent with downstream payment latency causing 502s. Redis reserve_inventory and postgres save_order succeeded, arguing against redis-timeout or db-pool-exhaustion. Payment logs were excluded, so internal cause is unconfirmed.
